title: Concurrent League Settings Conflict Resolution with Audit Trail
i_want: Clear handling when multiple people try to modify league settings simultaneously
so_that: Settings changes are applied consistently, conflicts are resolved transparently, and all changes are auditable

given: Commissioner A changes roster_size from 10 to 12
when: Commissioner A submits changes with version 5
A's changes commit successfully, incrementing to version 6
B submits changes with stale version 5
then: B's request returns HTTP 409 Conflict
Error message: 'Settings were modified by another user. Please review changes and resubmit.'
Response includes: current_version=6, your_version=5, conflicting_fields=['roster_size']
B's UI shows: 'Another admin changed roster_size to 12. Your changes have not been saved.'
B can review both changes and resubmit with merged values
Audit log shows: A's change at timestamp T1, B's conflict at T2

given: Both fields are independent with no validation dependencies
when: System detects no overlapping field conflicts
then: Both changes are applied successfully
Final state: roster_size=12, scoring_system='PPR', version=7
Audit log shows both changes with timestamps
Both commissioners see success messages
Email notification sent: 'League settings updated by multiple admins'
Changelog visible to all league members shows both changes

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Conflicting field changes with manual resolution
given: Commissioner A changes roster_size from 10 to 12
Commissioner B changes roster_size from 10 to 15
then: B receives HTTP 409 Conflict with detailed conflict info
Response payload: { conflicting_fields: [{ field: 'roster_size', your_value: 15, current_value: 12, changed_by: 'Commissioner A', changed_at: '2025-09-08T10:00:01Z' }] }
B's UI shows merge dialog: 'Commissioner A changed roster_size to 12. You tried to change it to 15. Choose which value to keep.'
Options: 'Keep A's value (12)', 'Use my value (15)', 'Enter different value'
B selects option and resubmits with version 6
Audit log records: A's original change, B's conflict, B's resolution

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Notification of conflicting changes to all parties
given: Commissioner B's changes conflict and are rejected
League has 3 commissioners: A, B, C
then: Commissioner A receives: 'Your settings changes saved. Commissioner B attempted conflicting changes.'
Commissioner B receives: 'Your changes conflicted with recent changes by Commissioner A. Please review and resubmit.'
Commissioner C receives: 'League settings modified by Commissioner A (roster_size). Commissioner B attempted conflicting change.'
All notifications include: timestamp, fields changed, who made changes
In-app notification banner for all commissioners
Email sent to all commissioners with full changelog

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Audit trail with complete change history
given: League has been active for 3 months with multiple settings changes
when: Commissioner requests full settings audit trail
then: Audit log displays chronologically: { timestamp, user, field, old_value, new_value, version, conflict_occurred, conflict_resolved_by }
Example entry: { timestamp: '2025-09-08T10:00:01Z', user: 'Commissioner A', field: 'roster_size', old_value: 10, new_value: 12, version: 6, conflict_occurred: false }
Conflict entry: { timestamp: '2025-09-08T10:00:05Z', user: 'Commissioner B', field: 'roster_size', old_value: 10, new_value: 15, version: 5, conflict_occurred: true, conflict_resolved: false }

Resolution entry: { timestamp: '2025-09-08T10:01:00Z', user: 'Commissioner B', field: 'roster_size', old_value: 12, new_value: 15, version: 7, conflict_occurred: false, resolution_of: 'audit_id_123' }
Filterable by: date range, user, field, conflict status
Exportable to CSV for external analysis

given: Commissioner wants to rollback to previous settings version
Want to rollback to version 7 (3 changes ago)
when: System checks for conflicts with current version 10
then: System shows diff: 'Rolling back will revert 3 changes: roster_size (12→10), scoring_system (PPR→Standard), waivers (FAAB→Rolling)'
Confirmation required: 'Are you sure you want to rollback these changes?'
On confirm, new version 11 created (rollback recorded as new change)
Audit log: { timestamp: '...', user: 'Commissioner A', action: 'rollback', from_version: 10, to_version: 7, new_version: 11, fields_reverted: [...] }
All commissioners notified of rollback
Rollback itself can conflict if another change occurs during rollback process

given: System uses optimistic locking with version numbers
when: Occasional conflicting changes on same field
then: Non-conflicting changes process immediately
Conflicting changes return 409 with retry guidance
System maintains < 100ms latency for conflict detection
Version numbers increment monotonically: 5→6→7→8...
No lost updates or corruption
Audit log remains complete and ordered
Metrics tracked: conflict rate, resolution time, retry success rate

version_control.increment: version = version + 1 on each successful update
version_control.update_pattern: UPDATE league_settings SET field=?, version=version+1 WHERE league_id=? AND version=?
version_control.conflict_detection: Check affected_rows = 0 to detect stale version

optimistic_locking.conflict_detection: Compare submitted version with database version
optimistic_locking.retry_strategy: Client-side retry with fresh version number

conflict_resolution.field_granularity: Track conflicts at individual field level
conflict_resolution.resolution_ui: Present conflict dialog with current vs. attempted values
conflict_resolution.resolution_tracking: Link resolution audit entries to original conflict

columns: timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
indexes: CREATE INDEX ON league_settings_audit(league_id, timestamp DESC)
CREATE INDEX ON league_settings_audit(user_id, timestamp DESC)
CREATE INDEX ON league_settings_audit(conflict_occurred) WHERE conflict_occurred = TRUE

notification_types.change_conflict: Your changes conflicted with recent changes

conflict_response.message: Settings were modified by another user. Please review changes and resubmit.

payload.retry_guidance: Fetch latest settings (version 6) and resubmit with merged changes

validation_failure.message: Settings validation failed: {field} has invalid value

payload.suggestion: Please choose a roster size between 8 and 20

performance_requirements.conflict_response_time: < 500ms at p99 including conflict field resolution

alerts: Conflict resolution time p99 > 5 minutes (users stuck)
Audit log write failures > 0 (data integrity risk)
Version number gaps detected (potential race condition)
dashboards: Real-time settings change timeline by league
Conflict occurrence heatmap (by field and time)

concurrent_testing: Test same-field conflicts (roster_size changed by A and B)
Verify audit log completeness under high concurrency
edge_cases: Version number overflow (after millions of changes)
Rollback to version that no longer exists
Conflict resolution submitted with stale version (double conflict)
audit_testing: Verify every change has corresponding audit entry
Test audit log filtering and searching
Verify conflict and resolution linking in audit log
Test audit log export with large datasets
notification_testing: Verify all commissioners notified of changes
Test notification delivery under high change volume

conflict_dialog.title: Settings Conflict Detected
conflict_dialog.message: Commissioner {name} changed {field} to {value} while you were editing.
conflict_dialog.visual_diff: Show side-by-side comparison: Their Value | Your Value

real_time_updates.mechanism: WebSocket or SSE for live updates
real_time_updates.notification_banner: Settings changed by {name} - Refresh to see latest
real_time_updates.auto_refresh_prompt: Your settings page is outdated. Click to refresh.

dependencies: PostgreSQL with transaction isolation for version updates
Audit logging table with appropriate indexes
Queue system for async notification dispatch
